name: minimax_image
description: Generate and analyze images through the MiniMax image and vision APIs

tools.name: minimax_image_generate
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt through MiniMax only when the user requests image generation. Paid call: no automatic retries or provider fallback. Returns a saved image path and dashboard download URL (or the provider URL when the model returns one), never base64.

prompt.description: Description of the requested image, composition, style, text and constraints

model.description: MiniMax image model id. Overrides context/environment default (image-01).

tools.name: minimax_image_analyze
tools.description: Describe or answer a question about an image through MiniMax vision. Accepts an HTTPS URL or a base64 data URI; local paths are not supported. Never invents analysis for unreadable images.

image_url.description: HTTPS image URL or data:image/...;base64 data URI

question.description: What to analyze about the image

model.description: MiniMax vision model id. Overrides context/environment default (MiniMax-VL-01).
